claims.statement: The manual describes a learning by doing method in which volunteers learn in the classroom and act in the community.
claims.quote: This is the learning by doing method: learn in the classroom, do in the community.

claims.statement: What volunteers learn responds to the priority areas of concern their own community has decided on.
